environment.description: Provider deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with the pod running under a gVisor (runsc) sandbox runtime class. The Terraform workspace is configured with Vault Agent sidecar injecting a PKCS#11 URI (pkcs11:token=prod-hsm;object=tf-aes-key?pin-source=/vault/secrets/hsm-pin) as the encryption_key variable. The actual PKCS#11 provider library (libsofthsm2.so) communicates with a Thales Luna Network HSM 7 partition via mTLS over a dedicated VPC endpoint. The HSM partition's access policy (partition policy template ID 22) has extractable=false and wrap-with-trusted=true set on all key objects. The pod's seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault augmented with a custom profile at /etc/seccomp/terraform-provider.json) blocks mmap with PROT_EXEC|PROT_WRITE simultaneously, and the gVisor sentry intercepts all raw memory syscalls. The TF_KEY_SLOT_LABEL is hardcoded in the Kubernetes ConfigMap to 'hsm-slot-0' (9 chars, well under 32-byte buffer). Node-level IMDSv2 hop limit is set to 1 with HttpPutResponseHopLimit preventing container credential theft.
